readme: The shipped builds the e2e upgrade suites start from. One entry per version: its GitHub release tag (the durable origin of BCSC-v<version>.apk / .ipa, attached per e2e/apps/README.md) and the platforms it ships for. Read by the weekly upgrade run (every version × every state its lineage supports), the monthly Sauce refresh, and the wdio upgrade configs (PREV_VERSION). Adding a version = attaching its assets to the release + one entry here.
